$comment: Root ADR-0280 (ownership), ADR-0281 (collected openly, politely, stopping when refused) and ADR-0283 (the User-Agent names us; a contact is optional). How 법원경매정보 (courtauction.go.kr) is asked, how slowly, when, and what makes a run stop. The collector (`collect-courtauction-go-kr` in services/foundation-outbox-publisher), the Silver load (infra/lakehouse/spark/jobs/courtauction_go_kr.py) and their tests read this file; nothing else restates these values. Checked 2026-10-19: no robots.txt (404); the list searches answer JSON to a plain POST with no session; one condition listed 17,863 items.

manners.$comment: ADR-0281 §1-§5. request_spacing_seconds is a floor a setting may only raise; a robots.txt Crawl-delay above it raises it too. One connection, no concurrency. A run starts only inside the quiet hours (KST) and sends no request after they end. max_requests_per_run bounds one night. Retries are for network errors only, never for a refusal.

refusal.$comment: ADR-0281 §3. Any of these ends the run at once as `refused` and blocks later runs until a person removes the state file the collector writes. An HTML body where JSON belongs (a login, notice, block or CAPTCHA page) and the site's own ipcheck=false are refusals too.

forbidden_in_collector.$comment: ADR-0281 §4. The collector's source must not contain these (a test reads it): no proxy, no rotation, no browser disguise, no CAPTCHA, no randomness in timing or identity.

item_search.$comment: 물건 검색 (진행 물건). cortAuctnSrchCondCd 0004601/0004602 and lclDspslGdsLstUsgCd 10000/20000 are the four combinations the site's own search form sends; the codes are stored as given, their meanings are not restated here. A pass is complete only when every combination was read to its last page.

sale_result_search.$comment: 매각결과 검색: the same row shape for items whose sale date has passed, with the sale amount.

detail.$comment: Root ADR-0285. Everything the detail collector asks, per case or per goods item, and how fast. The endpoint list is the one record of what is asked; request bodies name only the keys a case or item supplies. rate_control is a ceiling the code may not exceed: one HTTP/2 connection, at most max_in_flight requests in flight, starting at floor_requests_per_second (the 3-second gap), +increase_step after increase_after_clean_responses clean answers up to ceiling_requests_per_second, x decrease_factor at once when the night's p95 latency passes slowdown_latency_ratio times its baseline or a network error occurs. 429, 503 and Retry-After end the night (the next night starts at the floor); every other refusal signal (refusal above, robots.txt answered with HTML) stops until a person clears it. Photos (picFile, base64 in goods detail) are decoded into write-once objects named by SHA-256 under photo_object_prefix; the Bronze response keeps the hash and byte count in their place.

silver_load.$comment: What one Silver load may take (plan-silver-load-objects): objects of each search that no commit of its table records, landed within window_days, oldest first, at most max_objects per table (a week of nights). The window stays shorter than the snapshot retention (lakehouse-maintenance.contract.json retain_days, refused otherwise): an expired snapshot takes its load record with it.

pnu_resolution.$comment: ADR-0280 §4. The list rows carry no PNU. The 행정구역 names (hjguSido, hjguSigu, hjguDong, hjguRd) with the representative lot (daepyoLotno) are read as a jibun address, else rdNm with buldNo as a road address, through address_pnu.py with these 시도 prefixes (the registered-factory contract's, the same values).
